sara (AE): Hey team — Asteria Financial just sent the SIG. We need a question-by-question handoff for evidence. Can we triage the high-risk questions today? Main asks: KMS rotation proof, key custodians, SOC2 excerpts, and isolation details for Dedicated.
priya (Security): @sara noted. I'll own mapping questions -> artifact names. Quick clarifying Q: include Hosted-only screenshots or both Hosted + Dedicated diagrams?
SARA (AE): Both. They want to see parity between offerings. POC target week: Apr 7.
dan (SE): I can produce the Dedicated architecture diagram and a sanitized config snippet. Putting file names here: `dedicated-arch-asteria.png`, `kms-rotation-2025-03.pdf`, `soc2-type2-excerpt-2024.pdf`. I'll upload to the secure share.
jordan (SRE): For rotation audit logs, use the ops vault link (internal): https://vault.internal.redwood/asteria-audit — note access requires `team-sales` ACL. Sample grep to pull rotation events: `grep "key_rotation" /var/log/kms/audit.log | tail -n 50`.
priya (Security): Perfect. For the SIG Q:2 (Key management) I'll answer: "Keys are customer-isolated for Dedicated; Hosted uses customer KMS integration with RW-managed keys optional." Evidence attachments to cite: `kms-rotation-2025-03.pdf` (rotation certificates), `kms-policy-rotation.txt` (policy excerpt), and `kmscustodian-contactsheet.csv` (control owners).
sara (AE): Thx. Can someone confirm the control owner names for the form? They ask for emails.
priya (Security): Control owners: Priya Sharma (security@redwood.com), Jordan Lee (sre@redwood.com), Dan Wu (se@redwood.com). I'll paste this into the SIG Q:contact field.
dan (SE): Uploading sanitized config now to the share: linked path https://internal.redwood/share/sales/asteria/sig. Files uploaded: `dedicated-arch-asteria.png`, `dedicated-config-sanitized.yml`.
ops-bot: Deployment note: new upload detected to /share/sales/asteria/sig by dan (SE) at 1732467920.
priya (Security): Two small open items: 1) Need a screenshot of the RMF evidence portal for SOC2 mapping (I can grab in 30m). 2) Need confirmation whether Asteria requires UK residency statement — if yes, we'll include `data-residency-eu.md`. @sara please confirm with buyer.
sara (AE): Confirmed they require EU residency. I'll request the formal statement and get back. If we can get the SOC2 screenshot and KMS PDF by EOD, I'll assemble the SIG package and start upload.
priya (Security): Got it. I'll drop the SOC2 screenshot and `kms-rotation-2025-03.pdf` in the share by 17:30 PT.
dan (SE): If reviewers ask for a sample API call for retrieval, use this snippet:
```
curl -X GET "https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys/rotation?env=dedicated" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"
```
sara (AE): Great. I'll begin filling Q-by-Q in the SIG portal once uploads are in place. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
